name: llm-security-scanner
description: Scan LLM-backed applications you operate against the OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, interpret findings by evidence class, and remediate them. Wraps the llm-security-scanner CLI with a local Ollama judge.

settings.name: Ollama host
settings.description: Where the Ollama daemon used for the AI judge is reachable. Default: http://localhost:11434

settings.name: Scanner binary override
settings.description: Optional. Explicit command that runs llm-scanner, e.g. a path inside a pinned virtualenv or a 'docker run' shim. Leave empty to auto-detect.
